venira.avoid_when: you read or edit files (file tools) or run a tiny JS calculation (project_execute_js).
venira.output_kind: run_id, kill_key, running, exit_code, timed_out, stdout/stderr (background=0) or stdout_tail/stderr_tail. ok=true only means it ran: read command_status/exit_code. approval_required: ask the user to approve, then retry once with approval_id.
venira.speed_profile: background=1 returns in ~5 ms, run time is up to the command; background=0 blocks for the whole run (bounded by timeout_ms, default 10 min).
venira.use_when: you build, test, run git or install packages. Use background=0 for short commands whose output you need now.

description:
Run a shell command in the workspace (shell: powershell|cmd|bash, relative_cwd, timeout_ms). Default is background: returns run_id, poll project_shell_status. background=0 blocks until exit and returns stdout/stderr.
Use when: you build, test, run git or install packages. Use background=0 for short commands whose output you need now.
Avoid when: you read or edit files (file tools) or run a tiny JS calculation (project_execute_js).
Output: run_id, kill_key, running, exit_code, timed_out, stdout/stderr (background=0) or stdout_tail/stderr_tail. ok=true only means it ran: read command_status/exit_code. approval_required: ask the user to approve, then retry once with approval_id.

approval_id.description: Id from approval_required, granted by a human (`data.approval.approve_command` or client elicitation). Retry once.

approval_wait_ms.description: If approval is needed, wait up to this many ms (max 45000) for the human, then run in the same call.

background.description: 1 = background (default): return immediately with run_id. 0 = foreground: block until the command exits, then return the final stdout/stderr in this call.

dry_run.description: 1 = evaluate policy only; nothing runs, no approval is created (default 0).

override.description: Named exception; only works when the operator enabled this exact name in VENIRA_SHELL_OVERRIDES.

relative_cwd.description: Working directory inside the workspace (default: workspace root).

secret_env.description: Names of stored secrets (project_secret) to inject as environment variables for this command, e.g. ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]. The value never appears in the command, the audit log or the output.

shell.description: Default: VENIRA_DEFAULT_SHELL, else the host default. pwsh = PowerShell 7+, powershell = 5.1.

timeout_ms.description: Kill the process tree after this many ms (0/unset = 10 min; capped by VENIRA_SHELL_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS).
